summary: Streaming SSE disconnect during live demo (demo tenant) — client stream ends mid-response
description:
Issue summary
- During a live prospect demo using the Standard Demo v1 tenant, an SSE streaming response disconnected mid-generation.
- The UI (Console “Try it” panel) and the CLI fallback both showed the stream ending abruptly without a model-side error message.

Customer impact
- Prospect: Northstar AI (live demo) 
- Impact: Demo interruption + loss of confidence in reliability. We pivoted to a non-streaming response (“Plan B”) to finish the scenario.
- Duration: ~2–3 minutes during the call; reproducible after the call in the demo tenant from at least one corporate network.

Environment
- Demo tenant: rwd-demo-tenant (Hosted API)
- Region: us-east
- Route: /v1/chat/completions (stream=true)
- Client: Redwood Console (browser) + curl script from demo scenario bundle
- Model: rw-chat-large-2025-07-18 (pinned)

Steps to reproduce (observed)
1) Open Console → API → Chat → “Streaming chat” saved request.
2) Click Run with stream enabled.
3) After ~15–40 seconds, the stream stops. Console shows an incomplete assistant response; no final [DONE] event.

Expected result
- Stream completes with final [DONE] event; Console shows full response; request shows “success” in dashboard.

Actual result
- Stream terminates early; client sees connection closed.
- Server logs show the upstream continues briefly, but the client connection is closed (client-side close / proxy close) and we log a 499/stream write error.

Evidence / logs
- Time window: 2025-08-19 16:12–16:25 PT
- Request IDs (from Console):
  - req_01J5FQ7R9K6M2J9T8C3B2VYH8X
  - req_01J5FQ9C8Y4D9P7R2M1N0K3J5H
- Trace ID (gateway): 7b2d9c1e3a4f5b6c

Gateway log excerpt (api-gateway, us-east)
- 2025-08-19T23:18:41.902Z  INFO  request_start  request_id=req_01J5FQ7R9K6M2J9T8C3B2VYH8X route=/v1/chat/completions stream=true tenant=rwd-demo-tenant
- 2025-08-19T23:19:03.117Z  WARN  stream_write_failed request_id=req_01J5FQ7R9K6M2J9T8C3B2VYH8X err="write tcp ...: broken pipe" client_ip=***.***.***.*** user_agent="Mozilla/5.0" 
- 2025-08-19T23:19:03.118Z  INFO  request_end request_id=req_01J5FQ7R9K6M2J9T8C3B2VYH8X status=499 duration_ms=21216 bytes_out=18342

Serving runtime logs (model pod)
- 2025-08-19T23:19:02.842Z INFO stream_token_out request_id=req_01J5FQ7R9K6M2J9T8C3B2VYH8X token_idx=217
- 2025-08-19T23:19:03.301Z INFO stream_cancel_received request_id=req_01J5FQ7R9K6M2J9T8C3B2VYH8X reason=downstream_closed

Notes:
- This looks like downstream/client connection termination (499 + broken pipe) rather than a model crash.
- In a few reproductions, token cadence slowed (gaps of ~10–15s) when the tenant was concurrently used by internal dry runs.

Investigation notes / hypotheses
1) Corporate proxy / network middlebox closing SSE streams if there is a long pause without data (no heartbeat).
2) Demo tenant route had a stricter idle timeout than default for streaming (misconfiguration or legacy setting).
3) Console “Try it” panel might not send keepalive; browser may terminate under certain conditions.

Mitigation / workaround (for field)
- Use Plan B for live demos if streaming is flaky:
  - Toggle stream=false and run the same request (keeps narrative intact for quality + routing/fallback).
  - Or run the “Streaming chat (short)” canned prompt (keeps generation under ~10s).
  - If using curl: add --http1.1 and avoid running behind corp VPN when possible.

Resolution
- Hotfix applied in api-gateway for demo tenant route (us-east): enable periodic SSE heartbeat / comment frames every 5s while upstream is active, preventing idle disconnects by intermediaries.
- Also adjusted demo-tenant gateway idle timeout to match production streaming default.
- Verified after deployment: 20 consecutive streaming runs from Console + curl without disconnect; dashboards show 2xx with [DONE] events present.

Follow-ups
- Product/Platform: evaluate rolling SSE heartbeat globally for all tenants (not only demo) and document behavior.
- DevEx: update demo scripts/quickstart to include non-streaming fallback instructions and a “short streaming prompt” variant.
- Observability: add an explicit metric panel for status=499 on streaming routes in demo dashboards and alert if spikes during business hours.

Links
- Slack thread: #sales ("demo tenant is slow today" triage + streaming disconnect notes) — internal ref: thread-1723996001
- Demo dashboards: Demo Tenant → Streaming Health (errors/499) + API Gateway Latency panels (see monitoring doc)
- Related: SUP-18411 (throttling confusion during demo/trial; may contribute to latency/cadence issues when quota hits)
